name: La Pausa: Sunset House Party
description: Wind down the weekend with a sunset party featuring a groovy mix of Tech House, House, and Latin House. The perfect end to a busy week.
longDescription:
La Pausa: Sunset House Party is a nightlife event designed to offer a relaxed close to the weekend. This gathering focuses on a specific musical blend, featuring Tech House, House, and Latin House genres, curated to provide a distinct atmosphere as the sun sets. The event aims to create a celebratory yet unwinding environment for attendees.

Visitors can expect an evening characterized by a continuous flow of electronic music, suitable for dancing and socializing. The atmosphere is intended to be upbeat and social, catering to an adult audience interested in contemporary electronic music. The specific venue for this event is yet to be announced, but it will host an outdoor or semi-outdoor setting conducive to a sunset party experience.

Tickets for La Pausa: Sunset House Party will vary in price, with details to be released closer to the event date. Information regarding the exact location and transportation options will be provided once the venue is confirmed.
